_comment: MeshBench — the content workbench (FBX/BVH → staging). Rebuilt 2026-09-03 in the Populous shape: one paged_menu (page rail hidden) whose tab rail is the WORKFLOW's steps; a three-panel body (facts · view · controls) whose slices meshbench.lua's arrange() lights by (workflow, step); the standard nav_footer. The unsaved-work prompt is the SHARED choice_dialog modal the shell hosts (scenes/shared/), pushed over this scene — not an inline subtree. Every control is a catalog component with its standard props; the only styles are the shared blocks; each view surface HOSTS the `model_view` scene (ruling EBDB3518 — a nested surface is a complete scene: its corner label and isolate row are its own chrome, drawn inside its own target, and its `rig` stage is its own file’s).

nav_footer._comment: Bench nav rail band (the materialbench/catalog block, same values). `frame` = the node's own slab; `rule` (top hairline) + `label` (legend ink) resolve as the component's defaults.
nav_footer.label: $dim

rtt_holder._comment: The framed RTT HOLDER every bench's rtt/viewport slot styles against — the shared chrome for an offscreen-view slot (replaced the per-scene meshbench holder block, same values).
